
# Our Git workflow

**Principle.** Git produces merge conflicts when two people edit the same lines in
parallel. We therefore split the report into one master document
(`IEAP-Series02-RStudio.qmd`) and several sub-documents (`sections/_*.qmd`) that are
included at render time.

**Branches.**

- `main` is the graded branch. Nobody commits directly on it (except for the initial commit); it receives merges
  through pull requests on GitHub.
- One feature branch per question, created from an up-to-date `main`:
  `2.1-concepts` (Alexis), `2.2-prepost` (Vidusha),
  `2.3-Testing-some-sterotypes` (Chloé), `3-epilogue` (Alexis).
- `git-cheklist` for the shared section.
- `final`: last branch, used only to render and commit the PDF once everything is
  merged.

**Cycle for each question.**

1. Create a new branch for a new section
2. Work, then commit small, meaningful steps, e.g.
3. Push the branch and create a pull request on GitHub
4. Another team member reads the pull request and approves it; we merge into `main`

**Commit messages.** Each message contains what was added or changed with the commit
